analysis: The trial crashed after 45.84 allocated GPU-seconds and produced no validation score. The supplied traceback only reports train.py exiting with status 1; it does not expose the underlying exception, so the cause cannot be determined. Masked-denoising effectiveness and export agreement remain unverified. The historical 0.6062 and 0.6250 scores are comparison references, not results from this trial.
code_summary: The code trains a residual MultVAE independently for each of four categories and combines its candidate ranks with unchanged SASRec checkpoint ranks using the previously selected fixed fusion weight. MultVAE uses a normalized binary-history EmbeddingBag encoder, 256 hidden units, a 64-dimensional Gaussian latent variable, and a residual encoder-to-decoder connection. Training hides 20% of unique history items, leaves at least one visible item, and reconstructs only hidden targets; singleton histories reconstruct themselves. Full-catalog softmax, the original KL expression and annealing, Adam, and validation checkpoint selection are retained. The generated predictor loads both experts and uses complete unmasked histories. The implementation includes checkpoint staging, budget allocation, synthetic objective checks, reference comparisons, and predictor agreement checks, but the crash provides no evidence that these completed.
